A more comprehensive doc is probably in order, but these are the existing ones I'm aware of: - The 1.x blog series often mentions the topics, e.g. section "Code Chunking" here https://blog.ethereum.org/2020/01/28/eth1x-files-the-stateless-ethereum-tech-tree/ - Blog post I wrote some time ago https://medium.com/ewasm/evm-bytecode-merklization-2a8366ab0c90 - More data: https://ethresear.ch/t/some-quick-numbers-on-code-merkelization/7260 The main motivation is reducing block witness size in eth1x and more accurate pricing for which parts of code are executed cool thanks 🙂
